name: backendBitDifferences
description: Sampled values that differ, bit for bit, between the serial backend and the thread-pool or partitioned backend, over every graph, size and method

name: backendWorkDifferences
description: Runs whose reported work (global steps, node substeps, contributions evaluated) differs from the serial run of the same graph and method

name: workCountDifferences
description: Work counts that differ from what the model implies: N substeps a global step; each contribution once a substep under Euler, once a stage under Runge–Kutta 4

name: backendNotAsRequested
description: Runs whose effective backend or worker count is not the one requested (so a parallel backend really ran in parallel)

name: eulerExactStepsDifference
description: explicit Euler: largest difference from the method's exact steps (closed form for the chain and grid, stepped independently for the random network), relative to the largest starting temperature

name: eulerExactSolutionError
description: explicit Euler: largest error against the exact solution, K (chain and grid at every size, the random network by the matrix exponential at 100 nodes), h = 0.02 s to t = 1 s

name: rungeKutta4ExactStepsDifference
description: Runge–Kutta 4: largest difference from the method's exact steps (closed form for the chain and grid, stepped independently for the random network), relative to the largest starting temperature

name: rungeKutta4ExactSolutionError
description: Runge–Kutta 4: largest error against the exact solution, K (chain and grid at every size, the random network by the matrix exponential at 100 nodes), h = 0.02 s to t = 1 s

name: randomHeatConservation
description: Random network: largest drift of the total heat Σ C_i T_i from Konjugate's own states, relative to Σ C_i |T_i(0)|, over every size and method
